summary: QwenPaw commits eight 'official' aggregate result files (GAIA, SpreadsheetBench Verified, SWE-bench Verified, vendor-built PawBench) across versions, modes and two models, e.g. SWE-bench Verified score_sum 494.0/500, but by design omits per-task results and trajectories; the execution harness lives in a separate 'qwenpaw-index' repo, and PawBench is judged by qwen3.8-max even when it is also the agent. Memory-benchmark headlines (LongMemEval, BEAM, LOCA) are external (arXiv report, ReMe repo), and the visual-compression token savings come from an uncommitted single-author scenario.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
